result:
Everything looks in order — the `.guren/api-client.gen.ts` diff is the expected codegen regeneration reflecting `excerpt` becoming optional.

I made the excerpt optional and derived from the body when omitted:

- **`app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts`**: `excerpt` in `PostPayloadSchema` is now `.optional()` (dropped the `min(1, 'Excerpt is required.')`), so blank/whitespace-only/missing excerpt passes validation; title/body validation is unchanged.
- **`app/Models/Post.ts`**: added an exported `deriveExcerpt(body)` function implementing the 140-char, no-word-split, ellipsis (`…`) rule from the spec.
- **`app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`**: `store` and `update` now compute `excerpt = data.excerpt?.length ? data.excerpt : deriveExcerpt(data.body)` before saving, so a provided excerpt always wins, an empty one is re-derived from the (possibly new) body on every save, and the stored value is never empty.
- **`resources/js/pages/posts/New.tsx` / `Edit.tsx`**: relabeled the field "Excerpt (optional)" with a placeholder explaining the fallback; ran `bunx guren codegen` to regenerate `.guren/api-client.gen.ts` for the now-optional `excerpt` type.
- Added `tests/PostController.excerpt.test.ts` covering the derivation function directly (both worked examples plus edge cases) and the controller behavior (omitted/whitespace excerpt derives, provided excerpt wins and is trimmed, blank title/body still 422 with nothing saved, update re-derives from the new body).

`bun run typecheck`, `bun test` (13 pass, 0 fail), and `bunx guren check` all pass clean.
